ja: • 多層空母が1/1000スケールでキット化。
• 全長410ミリ。飛行甲板のブラストディフレクターは可動式。
• 同スケールの艦載機「デバッケ」21機のほか、オマケの「スヌーカ」も21機付属。

en: • Multilayer aircraft carrier is made into a kit at 1/1000 scale.
• Total length 410mm. The blast deflector on the flight deck is movable.
• In addition to 21 "Debacke" carrier-based aircraft of the same scale, 21 bonus "Snuka" are also included.
• The included bonus mecha collection is the space carrier fighter DWG109 "Debacke".
Molded product x 14, foil seal x 1, slide mark x 1, assembly manual x 1
